{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
[[File:Ueno kenji.jpg|thumb|Kenji Ueno, Madrid 2006]]
'''Kenji Ueno''' (上野 健爾, Ueno Kenji, 1945, [[Kumamoto Prefecture]]) is a Japanese mathematician, specializing in [[algebraic geometry]].<ref name="HomepageRef">[http://researchmap.jp/kenjiueno/?lang=english Ueno's homepage]</ref>

He was in the 1970s at the [[University of Tokyo]] and was from 1987 to 2009 a professor at the [[University of Kyoto]] and is now the director of [[Yokkaichi University]]'s [[Seki Kōwa]] Institute for Mathematics.<ref name=HomepageRef/> In 1978 he was an Invited Speaker (''Classification of algebraic manifolds'') at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Helsinki]].<ref>{{cite book|editor=Lehto, Olli|editor-link=Olli Lehto|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, 1978|year=1980|location=Helsinki|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=eQC7AAAAIAAJ|isbn=9789514103520}}</ref>

Ueno was a visiting professor at several universities, including the [[University of Bonn]] and the [[University of Mannheim]] in the 1970s.

He is the author and editor of several books on algebraic geometry.<ref>[http://researchmap.jp/kenjiueno/ Biographical information]</ref>

==Selected publications==
*''Algebraic Geometry'', 3 volumes, American Mathematical Society 1999, 2002, 2003 (Vol. 1 [https://www.ams.org/bookstore-getitem/item=MMONO-185 From Algebraic Varieties to Schemes], Vol. 2 [https://www.ams.org/bookstore-getitem/item=MMONO-197 Sheaves and Cohomology], Vol. 3 [https://books.google.com/books/about/Algebraic_Geometry_Further_study_of_sche.html?id=KO0CTNuvRIsC Further Studies of Schemes])
*{{cite book|title=Conformal Field Theory with Gauge Symmetry|publisher=American Mathematical Society|year=2008}}
*with Koji Shiga, Shigeyuki Morita: {{cite book|title=A Mathematical Gift: the interplay between topology, functions, geometry and algebra|volume=1 & 2|publisher=American Mathematical Society|year=2003|postscript=; based on lectures in Kyoto, 1996}} — [https://books.google.com/books/about/A_Mathematical_Gift.html?id=9xu_fuIhmnYC Volume 2]
*with Yuji Shimizu: {{cite book|title=Advances in Moduli Theory|publisher=American Mathematical Society|year=2001|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=N7zc8cLP_aoC|isbn=9780821821565}}
*{{cite book|title=Classification theory of algebraic varieties and compact complex manifolds|volume=439|series=Lecture Notes in Mathematics 439|publisher=Springer Verlag|year=1975|postscript=; based on lectures in Mannheim, 1972|doi=10.1007/BFb0070570|last1=Ueno|first1=Kenji|isbn=978-3-540-07138-9}}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Winters, Gayn B.|title=Review: ''Classification theory of algebraic varieties and compact complex manifolds'' by Kenji Ueno|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1977|volume=83|issue=3|pages=344–349|doi=10.1090/S0002-9904-1977-14258-4|doi-access=free}}</ref>

*{{cite journal|title=Classification of algebraic varieties, I|journal=Compositio Math.|volume=27|year=1973|pages=277–342|url=http://archive.numdam.org/ARCHIVE/CM/CM_1973__27_3/CM_1973__27_3_277_0/CM_1973__27_3_277_0.pdf}}
*{{cite journal|title=On algebraic fiber spaces of abelian varieties|journal=Mathematische Annalen|volume=237|year=1978|pages=1–22|url=https://eudml.org/doc/182795|doi=10.1007/bf01351555|last1=Ueno|first1=Kenji|s2cid=120564737}}
*with Joergen Andersen: {{cite journal|title=Geometric construction of modular functors from conformal field theory|journal=Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications|volume=16|issue=2|year=2007|pages=127–202|doi=10.1142/s0218216507005233|arxiv=math/0306235|last1=Andersen|first1=Jørgen Ellegaard|last2=Ueno|first2=Kenji|s2cid=11891378}}
